results.body:
<timestamp> - resetting all expectations and request logs
------------------------------------
<timestamp> - tlsMutualAuthenticationAllowBundledCa is fixed at startup and cannot be changed on a running server (it lets mTLS trust client certificates anyone can create, so a request to the control plane cannot enable it) - the supplied value false has been IGNORED and tlsMutualAuthenticationAllowBundledCa remains true; set it before the server starts (system property, environment variable or startup configuration) to change it
------------------------------------
<timestamp> - configuration updated via API
------------------------------------
<timestamp> - control plane PUT /mockserver/configuration changed TLS-sensitive configuration that lowers or alters security posture: 

  tlsMutualAuthenticationCertificateChain repointed ("{{root}}/tests/files/tls/fwd-ca.pem" -> "")

 — verify this was intended, especially as control plane authentication is disabled by default
------------------------------------
<timestamp> - configuration updated via API
------------------------------------
<timestamp> - tlsMutualAuthenticationAllowBundledCa is enabled, so mTLS trusts client certificates signed by the default CA bundled with MockServer, whose private key is published in the MockServer jar: ANYONE CAN CREATE A CLIENT CERTIFICATE MOCKSERVER ACCEPTS, with any subject, issuer or serial number, so mTLS does not authenticate clients and client certificate matchers can be satisfied by anyone; use this only for throwaway local tests
------------------------------------
<timestamp> - configuration updated via API
------------------------------------
<timestamp> - control plane PUT /mockserver/configuration changed TLS-sensitive configuration that lowers or alters security posture: 

  tlsMutualAuthenticationCertificateChain repointed ("" -> "{{root}}/tests/files/tls/fwd-ca.pem")

 — verify this was intended, especially as control plane authentication is disabled by default
------------------------------------
